newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yoshitomi, Green Cross to announce merger.
newsitem.headline: Yoshitomi, Green Cross to announce merger.

text.p: Yoshitomi Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd and Green Cross Corp said on Monday they would hold a news conference at 0800 GMT on their merger.
Osaka-based Green Cross has been at the centre of a scandal concerning HIV-tainted blood products after former Green Cross executives were indicted last October on charges of professional negligence.
The charges said the company's sale of HIV-tainted blood products in the 1980s resulted in the death of a patient.
The company faces compensation payments totalling about 24 billion yen to people who were infected with HIV through its contaminated blood products.
The company said in November 1996 that it expects to post a parent current loss of 2.5 billion yen and sales of 68 billion yen in the year ending in March 31.
The company was hit by a sharp fall in its sales as public outrage over the scandal prompted boycotts of Green Cross products at many medical institutions throughout Japan.
Yoshitomi Pharmaceutical is also based in Osaka and is the 17th largest Japanese drug maker in terms of sales.
The company is also affiliated with the industry leader, Takeda Chemical Industries Co.
